page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is a bare-metal style virtualized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs using Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a physical execution core, eliminating hyperthreading resource contention. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with the instance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core density make this instance suitable for workloads requiring predictable, non-shared compute resources. The absence of hyperthreading ensures consistent performance per core, which is advantageous for high-performance computing, large-scale web serving, enterprise databases, and compute-heavy batch processing where resource sharing is undesirable.

Designed for high-density compute workloads, this server is well-suited for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, and compute-intensive batch processing that demand predictable performance and high network throughput.
